entities.summary: Vyacheslav Vladimirovich Ponomarev is a former owner of a soap production company who in 2014 briefly achieved prominence as the self-proclaimed mayor of the city of Sloviansk, at that time a focal point at the beginning of the 2014 War in Donbas.
